en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Abdullah, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Abu Imran Al Armany, from Ali Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If you were to participate a thousand in your Hajj, there would be a Hajj for each one, from without there being a reduction of anything in your Hajj’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ahmad ibn ‘Abd Allah has narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from abu ‘Imran al-Armaniy from Ali ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

has said that abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ’Even if you share your al-Hajj with a thousand people, still there will be one al-Hajj for every one without any reduction in your al-Hajj.’”
